blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — At least eight local government units (LGUs) in Bulacan province have suspended their classes on Tuesday (Oct. 13) due to the expected widespread water interruptions caused by the maintenance and shutdown of the Bulacan Bulk Water Supply of the Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System (MWSS) from Tuesday to Wednesday.
